Selected work

Under development

Smart Meetings
Notes Generator

My final-year web development project explores a practical question. How can someone find the decisions and next steps from a meeting without replaying the recording?

The workflow uses Whisper to transcribe audio and a language model to extract a summary, key points and action items.

  • React
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Node.js / Express
  • Groq
